changelog:
- Official Search Engine Logos: Rendered exact official vector logos matching reference for Microsoft Bing (Fluent ribbon 'b'), Google (4-color G), DuckDuckGo (Dax duck badge), Ecosia (standalone tree canopy & trunk), Brave (lion shield), and Startpage (capital letter 'S' with purple accent underline).
- Bulky Curvy Webpage Command Card: Matched the floating webpage address/command bar to the home command card design with a sleek 28dp rounded dark pill, 56dp height, engine capsule selector, glowing cyan mic, circular black-bordered tab counter, and pure white three-dots menu.
- Spacious Long Text Input: Expanded command card height and implemented automatic action folding when typing, giving full-width space for entering long queries with 1-tap clear button and adaptive font sizing.
